criteria: English, <=80 words, one paragraph, no headings/questions/emoticons/jokes
Accessible author voice without forced dialogue or stock humor
No invented lived experience or external unsupported claims
hard_failures: Violation of explicit output/format constraints, altered protected facts/stance, invented evidence/experience, unauthorized article/tool side effect, incorrect mechanism
pass: No hard failure and every criterion >=1; total >=8/10. Report full/partial scores and quoted evidence, not binary alone.
